title: AuditVeto
description: Line A Institution Engineering close-loop gap #2 (I_PROCESS_AUDIT + I_DESIGN_FEEDBACK): a non-production oversight seat's mechanical veto of a specific upstream mission node, written via the seat's always-on `fs.write` tool to a well-known filename in its own mission workspace (same convention as retro_request.schema.json / O_RETRO_INVOKE) — no new engine tool call surface. Presence of a schema-valid, *authorized* signal is what mechanically reopens `target` (see sciteam/audit_veto.py::VetoUpstreamReviser); an unauthorized seat's veto file is scanned but never honored (fail-closed authority check, mirrors artifact_emit_roles).

target.description: Mission/node id in the campaign's DAG to mechanically reopen (AdaptiveCampaignPlanner.reopen_upstream target).

vetoed_by.description: agent_key of the vetoing oversight seat.

detail.description: Optional free-text context; carries no authority.
